sloka: धर्मात्मा तस्य तथ्येन भ्रातुर्वाक्येन विस्मित: ।उवाच राम: सम्प्रेक्ष्य पौरजानपदं जनम् ॥ २.१११.२७॥
transliteration: dharmātmā tasya tathyena bhrāturvākyena vismita: ।uvāca rāma: samprekṣya paurajānapadaṁ janam ॥ 2.111.27॥

translations.english: On hearing the genuine sentiments of his brother, righteous Rama was astonished. He said to the inhabitants from towns and villages:
